title: Grant-time OPTIONS probe is an internal network scanner and reachability oracle
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka; component: Webhooks.API/
rationale: Adds a fail-closed public-host gate at the top of TestGrantUrl before any outbound request: both attacker-supplied URLs must parse as absolute http/https and resolve via DNS to at least one address with ALL resolved addresses public (reject-if-any-non-public defeats mixed A/AAAA records). Denylist covers IPv4 private/loopback/link-local incl. cloud metadata/CGNAT/documentation/reserved, and IPv6 ::/112, ::ffff:0:0/96 (normalized), NAT64, fe80::/10, fec0::/10, fc00::/7, ff00::/8, Teredo, documentation, 6to4. WebhooksSender untouched (f017's finding).
variants_checked: Two direct HttpClient uses in Webhooks.API — the grant probe (fixed here) and the sender (f017); WebhooksRetriever is DB-only; functional tests stub the service so no callers to fix.
bypass_considered: DNS rebinding TOCTOU vs SendAsync's own resolution remains (needs connection pinning); redirects gain no liveness oracle (outcome is a boolean against the token echo); empty-token oracle unchanged (protocol, not network reachability).
test_note: Omitted — no Webhooks.API unit-test project exists and functional tests stub the service; suggested range-helper assertions documented in the patch.
review_reason: Egress validation before the sink, fail-closed on parse/DNS failure, root-cause rather than symptom masking; helpers confined to the same class.
